summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long XNDU Daily ETF (XNDX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Xanadu Quantum Technologies, Inc., (Nasdaq: XNDU). XNDU is a quantum computing company developing photonic quantum hardware and software platforms for scalable, cloud-based quantum computing. XNDX was launched on May 6, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
